linked_information.resolution: Both original readers followed the source links. Their contemporaneous notes called the molecular reconstruction blocked; the 2026-10-16 model update subsequently derived the adapter/primer geometry from already reviewed published oligos. The run-specific physical primer inventory remains a separate blocked claim.

missing_claims.claim: The complete post-PCR library and sequencing-primer binding sites are not yet represented.
missing_claims.evidence: The publisher primer workbook prints both blocked TGIRT starters, the full-length R1MER family, the SCP7 PCR primer and 25 indexed Ad1 primers. Combining the two starter handles and Ad1/SCP7 gives a P5–i5–S5–ME–N–insert–N–SCR2 donor complement–UMI–P7 duplex; four standard-primer-compatible sites and both PCR binding sites are computed in the protocol model. Insert and overhang bases vary per molecule.

missing_claims.claim: The physical sequencing-primer oligos loaded for the reported NextSeq 500 run are not identified by the inspected protocol and analysis files.
missing_claims.evidence: Article, three supplements, detailed protocol, and pinned author analysis tree were inspected twice; the NextSeq vendor guide states the run-specific primer positions are recorded in Primers.xml, which is not among the linked author files. Vendor guides still need a second independent source check before absence can be accepted. The paper Results first-base interpretation also conflicts with the standard 34-base TruSeq R2 primer geometry: a fixed T would be read first, while a 35-base custom primer could skip it. The official Illumina adapter-sequence guide now has first-pass inspection only.

conclusion: The original article, all three publisher supplements, supplement index, pinned full author code, preprint and all three chemistry-linked predecessor sources have two located independent checks. Published oligos resolve the final duplex architecture, exact PCR binding regions and standard-primer-compatible Read 1, UMI/i7, i5 and Read 2 sites; the protocol model and page now render them. NextSeq 500 vendor operation guides have first-pass checks and need independent second passes. The actual run-specific loaded primer oligos are still not established; no absence claim is accepted. The paper's claim that the first Read 2 base reports RNA terminal identity is unresolved under the standard 34-base primer because the published donor has a fixed extra T; a custom 35-base primer could change that but is not recorded.
